```mcstas
DEFINE INSTRUMENT optimized_guide(
    w_in = 0.012,       // Guide entry width/height [m]
    w_out = 0.045,      // Guide exit width/height [m]
    m_coat = 3.0        // Supermirror m-value [-]
)

DECLARE
%{
%}

INITIALIZE
%{
%}

TRACE

COMPONENT o = Progress_bar()
AT (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

// Source: 10x10 cm source emitting lambda = 5.0 +- 0.5 Angstrom
COMPONENT source = Source_simple(
    radius = 0,
    xwidth = 0.1,
    yheight = 0.1,
    dist = 1.5,
    focus_xw = w_in,
    focus_yh = w_in,
    lambda0 = 5.0,
    dlambda = 0.5
)
AT (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT m_src = L_monitor(
    nlam = 100,
    filename = "source_lambda.dat",
    xwidth = 0.1,
    yheight = 0.1,
    Lmin = 4.0,
    Lmax = 6.0,
    restore_neutron = 1
)
AT (0, 0, 1.5) ABSOLUTE

// 1.5 m from source to guide entry
COMPONENT arm_guide_start = Arm()
AT (0, 0, 1.5) ABSOLUTE

// 10 m straight (or converging/diverging) supermirror guide
COMPONENT guide = Guide_anyshape(
    w1 = w_in,
    h1 = w_in,
    w2 = w_out,
    h2 = w_out,
    l = 10.0,
    m = m_coat
)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE arm_guide_start

// 5 cm behind guide exit to sample / divmon
COMPONENT arm_sample = Arm()
AT (0, 0, 10.05) RELATIVE arm_guide_start

COMPONENT divmon = Divergence_monitor(
    filename = "divmon.dat",
    xwidth = 0.02,
    yheight = 0.02,
    maxdiv_h = 0.5,
    maxdiv_v = 0.5,
    restore_neutron = 1
)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE arm_sample

END
```
